## Summary

Created a Go module `github.com/amansha/objx` with a fluent, chainable API for `map[string]interface{}` data:

- **`map.go`** — `Map` type + `New`/`MSI`/`FromJSON` constructors, `Get`, `Has`, `Keys`, `JSON`/`MustJSON`
- **`access.go`** — dotted-path + array-index selector parsing (`"a.b[0].c"`)
- **`value.go`** — `Value` wrapper with typed, default-falling-back accessors (`Str`, `Int`, `Int64`, `Float64`, `Bool`, `Map`, `Slice`, `StrSlice`) plus `Is*`/`Must*` variants, and chained `Get`
- **`manipulate.go`** — `Set` (creates intermediate maps), `Copy`, `Merge`/`MergeHere`, `Exclude`/`Include`
- **`objx_test.go`** — covers all of the above

`go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./... -v` all pass.
